protocol_description: Study province used for randomization stratification (Cajamarca, Cajabamba, San Marcos).
validation_notes: Directly observed. Defines the 3 trial strata. Aggregates to cluster level with 158 clusters strictly in 1 province and 1 cluster (104) spanning 2 provinces.

protocol_description: Total community census population size prior to trial enrollment.
validation_notes: Pre-randomization community census population size is absent. The observed number of enrolled participants per cluster (1 to 42) reflects post-randomization study enrollment, not community population size. Do not substitute enrolled sample size for cluster population size.

protocol_description: Administrative annual births per community/cluster from health center records.
validation_notes: Administrative health registry birth figures used during constrained randomization are absent from the released dataset.

protocol_description: Geographic elevation / altitude above sea level for each community.
validation_notes: Geographic altitude coordinates/values are completely absent from the released dataset.

protocol_description: Baseline community or household mobile phone ownership rate.
validation_notes: Baseline household cell-phone ownership is not in the released dataset. Endline awareness variable el_afinidata4 ('heard of Afini') and el_afinidata1 ('daily cellphone internet hours') are post-intervention measures and cannot substitute for baseline phone ownership.
Recorded at participant level (6-level ordinal). Aggregated to cluster-level proportions for balance diagnostics. Pre-randomization community-wide educational attainment is absent.
Recorded as baseline SES index quintiles (1-5) for enrolled participants. Aggregated to cluster-level mean for balance diagnostics. Pre-randomization community-wide wealth census is absent.
